welcome.title: Welcome! Shall we look around?
welcome.body: Thirty seconds to find your bearings. Nothing to memorise — it all stays on screen.

progress.title: Your progress
progress.body: This is where you stand: what is done, what is left. The bar fills itself as your documents come out.

steps.title: Your journey, in order
steps.body: Nine steps, from the idea to going live. The next ones stay closed until the current one is done — on purpose: one thing at a time, and nothing forgotten.

current.title: Your current step
current.body: The only one asking anything of you. Hit "Start" and IDEM takes you to the right place, then brings you back here.

switch.title: Switch modes whenever you like
switch.body: This button moves you between step-by-step guidance, chat and the full dashboard. Your project and documents stay exactly as they are.

done.title: You are all set!
done.body: All that is left is to begin. And if it ever feels too narrow, the mode switcher is your way out.

welcome.title: Welcome! Shall we look around?
welcome.body: A few seconds to find your bearings in Chat mode.

composer.title: Just say what you need
composer.body: Write as you would to an adviser: "draft me a business plan", "suggest some colours". IDEM understands and produces the document.

conversations.title: Your conversations, sorted
conversations.body: Each one is filed by topic — brand, finance, legal. You can see at a glance what you have already asked for.

export.title: Take everything with you
export.body: This button downloads every document produced for this project at once, as PDFs.

switch.title: Switch modes whenever you like
switch.body: This button moves you between step-by-step guidance, chat and the full dashboard. Your project and documents stay exactly as they are.

done.title: You are all set!
done.body: Ask your first question — IDEM handles the rest.

welcome.title: Welcome! Shall we look around?
welcome.body: Thirty seconds to find your bearings in your workspace.

switch.title: Switch modes whenever you like
switch.body: This button moves you between step-by-step guidance, chat and the full dashboard. Your project and documents stay exactly as they are.

done.title: You are all set!
done.body: Over to you. The dashboard hides nothing: every module is reachable from the left-hand menu.

project.title: The open project
project.body: This selector shows which project you are working on. Everything on screen relates to it — and you can switch from here.

nav.title: All your tools
nav.body: Brand, business plan, finance, legal, website, deployment: each module has its page. Nothing is locked — take them in whatever order suits you.
